note: Rooftop Word Golf (M9, WG). Three holes in course units (x right, y down), each hole 100 x 150. The green is the playing area; its edges are rails. Geometry is checked by src/themes/elevator-quest/minigames/wordGolf/course.ts and proved solvable by course.test.ts. `copy` holds the putting words and the screen-reader words; the spelling words, the labels shared with the spelling (CHECK, UNDO, CLEAR, HELP, BACK) and Lifty's lines are EC's (wordGolf.json). Plain, short, never a score.

holes.name: Straight Shot
holes.intro: A long, straight green. Aim at the flag and pick a power that is not too hard.

holes.name: Angle Shot
holes.intro: The flag is over to the side. Turn your aim toward it before you putt.

holes.name: Around the Wall
holes.intro: A wall is in the way. Putt around its end, or bounce off the round post.

copy.backHint: Goes back to the elevator. Your game is saved.
copy.hearItHint: Says the word and a sentence with it.
copy.aimPrompt: Aim at the flag. Pick a power. Then PUTT.
copy.aimDrag: Or touch the green where the ball should go.
copy.short: A little short. Try a bit more power.
copy.tooFast: Too fast! It rolled over the cup. Try less power.
copy.wide: Not in yet. Aim again from where the ball is now.
copy.out: That one hopped off the green. Try again from where it was.
copy.aimValueLittleLeft: Aimed a little left of the flag
copy.aimValueLittleRight: Aimed a little right of the flag
copy.moveCloserHint: Puts the ball nearer the flag. The next putt is still yours.
copy.moved: Nearer the flag now. Aim and putt.
